'''''Rhododendron caucasicum''''', the '''Caucasian rhododendron''' or the '''Georgian snow rose''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Rhododendron]]'' native to the [[Transcaucasus]] and [[Anatolia]].<ref name="332128-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:332128-1 |title=''Rhododendron caucasicum'' Pall. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=4 November 2020 }}</ref> Its hybrid cultivar 'Christmas Cheer' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=''Rhododendron'' 'Christmas Cheer' (''caucasicum'' hybrid) rhododendron 'Christmas Cheer' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/91155/i-Rhododendron-i-Christmas-Cheer-(-i-caucasicum-i-hybrid)/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=4 November 2020 }}</ref>
